sic: the first sort is an italic CAPITAL I (flat serifs top and bottom, margin-2.jpg at 11x), not the lowercase l of notes b and c ('l. ſi.', 'l fin.'), although the citation wants l. (lex) manifeſta, D. de iureiurando. Wrong sort, transcribed as printed.

the line-end word-break in manife|ſta is printed as a round point on the baseline, not as the raised dash used at the end of the next line ('iu-'); transcribed as the point that is printed. A worn hyphen sort cannot be ruled out.

the note's key letter is a heavily inked blob (margin-3.jpg at 9x) whose counter is closed; read c from the marker alphabet a b c d e and from the {c} marker in the body. No point is printed after the 'l' of 'l fin.' (unlike 'l.' in note b).
